purpose: Separate axial discretization, transverse viscous operator, inlet representation and pressure-station effects in the prior synthetic 3D duct pressure discrepancy. Diagnostic study only; no replacement of original validation.

immutable_original_pressure_grid_gate.status: FAILED; retained regardless of new results

geometry_properties_physics: Exactly original research/openfoam_3d/plan.json and study.py. 30 x 4 x 2 mm, rho=1.2 kg/m3, mu=1.8e-5 Pa s, constant-property steady incompressible laminar. Momentum only; no new thermal solve, no CHT, no aircraft/experimental claim.

new_supplementary_cases.name: discrete_developed_inlet
new_supplementary_cases.inlet: Fully developed solution of independent cell-centered transverse finite-volume Poisson operator, scaled to 3 m/s face-area mean. Only this supplementary case changes inlet shape; excludes it from matched-BC ladders.

physical_flow_condition: Every primary inlet uses original analytical face-midpoint profile rescaled to area-integrated flow Q=3*W*H=2.4e-5 m3/s. This fixes physical flow rate; midpoint normalization changes the equivalent continuous-profile amplitude and is reported separately, never used to silently redefine truth. Supplementary discrete inlet also has same Q.
numerical_operators: Original Gmsh setup, simpleFoam, fvSchemes, fvSolution, velocity pressure outlet/wall conditions and stopping criteria reused byte-for-byte except generated mesh/inlet arrays; no thermal solves. zero initial flow. Supplemental inlet is explicitly distinct.

reference_truth.pressure: Fully developed continuum rectangular Poiseuille target at fixed physical Umean=3 m/s, G=mu Umean/(H^2 exact_mean). This is not exact truth for the finite-duct mesh-dependent inlet profile plus inlet-pressure zeroGradient closure.
reference_truth.velocity: Report analytical point-value and exact cross-sectional cell-average L2 at fixed Umean=3 m/s separately. Analytical equivalent-mean reference is diagnostic only.
reference_truth.discrete_operator: Independent scipy sparse solution -laplacian_perp(v)=1 on uniform cell centers, internal coefficient 1/d^2, Dirichlet wall contribution 2/d^2 at half-cell wall distance. G_discrete=mu*Umean/mean(v). Stencil residual and analytical convergence tested; this is same-operator diagnostic, not independent full-3D PDE validation. The remaining difference is combined inlet/end/axial/coupling influence until the supplementary inlet case supports further attribution.

measurements: Primary pressure-gradient least-squares fit of section means on x/L=0.25..0.75, same original definition. Also report 0.10..0.90 and 0.40..0.60 windows and downstream asymmetric 0.60..0.90 window, sectional p and -dp/dx, inlet-owner to outlet drop separately.
Pressure-corrected phi integrated on every streamwise mesh face; section velocity means, inlet and outlet volume flux; relative mass imbalance and maximum station flux departure from prescribed Q.
Axial ladder (40,32,16),(80,32,16),(160,32,16); transverse ladder (80,16,8),(80,32,16),(80,64,32),(80,128,64). Existing F provides interaction cross-check: F-B=(A-B)+(T-B)+(F-A-T+B).
Exact inlet quadrature normalization; Gdiscrete vs Gcontinuum; observed G vs Gdiscrete; difference caused by discrete-developed inlet at B.

Observed order from signed monotonically converging equal-ratio three-grid differences only when finite, same sign, contracting differences and positive observed order, |difference| exceeds 100 times saved original stationarity level (1e-8 relative floor). Richardson estimate then marked conditional, no GCI/uncertainty bound. Also known-truth error ratios. Axial ladder with dominant transverse offset is not extrapolated to continuum truth.

predeclared_interpretation.directional_attribution_support: Call transverse refinement dominant only if |T-B|/(|T-B|+|A-B|) >=0.90 and |interaction| <=0.10*|F-B|; otherwise report coupled/unresolved.
predeclared_interpretation.operator_attribution_support: Call fully developed transverse operator an adequate explanation only if |Gobserved-Gdiscrete| <=0.10*|Gobserved-Gcontinuum| at B and transverse_fine; otherwise residual inlet/axial influence remains material.
predeclared_interpretation.no_threshold_rewrite: All limits defined before new runs. Original failure remains. New fixed-axial transverse refinement cannot certify original all-direction gate. No automatic CHT advancement.

reproducibility: Fresh output namespace only; register plan/source SHA before first solver; preserve prior scripts and original full artifacts; hash new native dictionaries mesh fields logs, save actual comparison plots and compact source-backed package <10 MB. Audit and independent review before parent delivery.
publication: Local only; no remote push, merge, deployment, application integration or broad physics upgrade.
pre_run_review: Independent reviewer audited all 26 original compact hashes and 220 full-source hashes. Before new solver runs, added asymmetric downstream station fit, contracting positive-order requirement and finite-duct versus fully-developed reference distinction. No new solver results existed when plan was frozen.
